vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2207: pan done that fails mid-flight (e.g. GraphQL rate limit at PR creation) leaves an issue done-but-never-reviewed — no recovery

plan.title: pan done mid-flight failure leaves work done-but-never-reviewed — no recovery
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: A work agent finishes and runs `pan done`, but `pan done` fails mid-flight — e.g. a GitHub GraphQL rate limit during PR creation (Step 2, done.ts:742). Execution falls into the catch block at done.ts:988 (process.exit(1)) BEFORE the completed marker (Step 4, done.ts:780) and `reviewRequestedAt` (Step 6, done.ts:840) are written. Result: PR is open + mergeable and all beads are closed, yet reviewStatus=pending and reviewRequestedAt is empty, so the review convoy is never dispatched and nothing re-dispatches it. The issue sits done-but-never-reviewed forever. Observed on PAN-2203 (2026-07-01): agent created the PR via REST by hand but never re-ran `pan done`; operator noticed only by asking. Compounding the fragility, createReviewArtifactsForIssue's own idempotency guard (getExistingGitHubArtifact) uses GraphQL when GitHub App is configured, so it ALSO throws under the same rate limit.
narratives.Proposal: Two independent layers, matching the PAN-2143/PAN-2200 reconciler shape. (1) Resilience in `pan done`: wrap Step 2 in try-catch; on failure, detect an already-open PR via the REST CLI (`gh pr list`, which survives GraphQL rate limits) and, if found, record the PR URL and proceed to write the completed marker + reviewRequestedAt instead of exiting. Also clear the recovery tombstone on every `pan done` re-run. (2) Recovery in the deacon: a new `checkOrphanedCompletions` patrol detects `reviewStatus=pending + reviewRequestedAt empty + open PR on GitHub (via REST)` and writes `reviewRequestedAt` to trigger the existing `needsReviewDispatch` auto-dispatch path, guarded by a durable `panDoneRecoveredAt` tombstone in the per-issue record so it fires at most once per stuck issue.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Making `pan done` atomic/transactional (rollback on any step failure) — the sequential-idempotent approach is sufficient and less invasive.
- Fixing or working around GitHub GraphQL rate limits themselves (external constraint).
- Reconciling the historical PAN-2203 incident's data — the patrol self-heals going forward only.
- Changing the strike-completion path (`pan done --strike`, done.ts ~480-511) — it bypasses PR creation entirely.
- Using GraphQL for either the fallback or the patrol PR-existence check — REST `gh pr list` only (it must survive the rate limit).

autoDecisions.summary: Merged the PRD's W1 (FR-1 resilient step 2) and FR-4 (clear tombstone on re-run) into ONE done.ts bead instead of splitting.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both edit src/cli/commands/done.ts; splitting would force serialization to avoid a merge/file conflict for zero reviewability gain. The PRD authored them as a single work item (W1) with one test file.

autoDecisions.summary: Use `ensureIssueRecordSync` (record.ts:439) to obtain-or-default the per-issue record; do NOT call the PRD's `buildDefaultRecord` or `updateIssueRecordForReviewStatusSync`.
autoDecisions.rationale: Grep-verified on 2026-07-06: neither helper exists. `ensureIssueRecordSync` returns an existing record or a fully-formed default, which is exactly what the tombstone write needs before `writeIssueRecordSync`.

autoDecisions.summary: Wire the patrol into `runPatrol()` (deacon.ts:2599), not `runScheduledPatrol` as the PRD text states.
autoDecisions.rationale: The `checkMissingReviewStatuses()` anchor (deacon.ts:2861) lives inside runPatrol; runScheduledPatrol merely calls runPatrol. The grep anchor is unambiguous regardless of the PRD's function-name error.

autoDecisions.summary: No bead uses the work.inspect gate (0 inspection beads).
autoDecisions.rationale: Every bead is mechanically specified with before/after code and a dedicated regression test; no bead consumes another's internal structure beyond a trivial optional type field, so a wrong implementation surfaces at typecheck/test rather than as silent foundation rot.

expected_outputs: lint passes with no new any

narrative.Action: In `src/lib/pan-dir/record.ts`, add an optional `panDoneRecoveredAt?: string` field to the `PanIssuePipelineRecord` interface (grep anchor `export interface PanIssuePipelineRecord {` at record.ts:84; insert after the `deaconIgnoredReason?: string;` line at record.ts:110). This durable tombstone is written by the deacon patrol (b3) when it recovers a stuck-pending issue, and cleared by `pan done` (b2) on re-run. Add a doc comment citing PAN-2207. No helper functions are needed — existing `readIssueRecordSync`/`writeIssueRecordSync`/`ensureIssueRecordSync` already round-trip arbitrary pipeline sub-fields.

items.title: Given a per-issue record whose `pipeline.panDoneRecoveredAt` is set to an ISO string, when it is written via `writeIssueRecordSync` and read back via `readIssueRecordSync`, then the field persists (round-trips) and `npm run typecheck` completes without errors.
No new explicit `any` is introduced; `npm run lint` passes.
pan done: REST fallback on PR-creation failure + clear recovery tombstone on re-run

expected_outputs: done-resilient-step2.test.ts passes (both fallback-success and fallback-empty cases)

narrative.Action:
In `src/cli/commands/done.ts`, make the review-artifact step resilient and clear the recovery tombstone on re-run.

(FR-1) Wrap the `createReviewArtifactsForIssue` call (grep anchor `const artifactResult = await Effect.runPromise(createReviewArtifactsForIssue(issueId, workspacePath));` at done.ts:742) in try-catch. On failure, run a REST-only PR lookup: `gh pr list --head feature/<issueLower> --state open --json url --jq '.[0].url'` via the existing `execAsync` (done.ts:8) with `cwd: workspacePath`. If a URL is found, log a warning, call `setReviewStatusSync(issueId, { prUrl })`, and synthesize a minimal `artifactResult` (`{ mergeSet: null, artifacts: [{ repoKey: 'primary', created: false, skipped: false, url: existingPrUrl }] }`) so downstream reads (`artifactResult.mergeSet?.repos.find(...)`, `artifactResult.artifacts.filter(a => !a.skipped && a.url)`, and `isMergeSetMergedIntoTargets(workspacePath, null)` — verified null-safe at done.ts:307) continue to Step 3/4/6. If no URL is found, re-throw the original error (preserve exit-1 behavior).

(FR-4) After the closed-issue guard and before the pre-flight block (near done.ts:574), clear any stale recovery tombstone: import `resolveProjectForIssue`/`readIssueRecordSync`/`writeIssueRecordSync` from `../../lib/pan-dir/record.js`; if the per-issue record's `pipeline.panDoneRecoveredAt` is set, write the record back with that field removed. Wrap in try-catch (non-fatal). A re-run of `pan done` supersedes any patrol recovery.

Write `tests/unit/cli/commands/done-resilient-step2.test.ts`: (a) mock createReviewArtifactsForIssue to throw + mock execAsync so `gh pr list` returns a URL → assert setReviewStatusSync is called with the prUrl and execution reaches the completed-marker write (exit 0); (b) mock createReviewArtifactsForIssue to throw + execAsync returns empty → assert the original error is re-thrown (exit non-zero).

items.title: Given createReviewArtifactsForIssue throws and `gh pr list --head feature/<id> --state open` returns a PR URL, when `pan done` runs, then it records the URL via setReviewStatusSync, writes the completed marker, sets reviewRequestedAt, and exits 0.
Given createReviewArtifactsForIssue throws and `gh pr list` returns empty, when `pan done` runs, then it re-throws the original error and exits non-zero.
Given a per-issue record with `pipeline.panDoneRecoveredAt` set, when `pan done` re-runs, then it clears panDoneRecoveredAt from the record before the pre-flight checks.
`tests/unit/cli/commands/done-resilient-step2.test.ts` exercises the fallback-success and fallback-empty paths and passes.
Deacon checkOrphanedCompletions patrol: recover PR-open + review-pending issues

narrative.Action:
In `src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts`, add `export async function checkOrphanedCompletions(): Promise<string[]>` (alongside the sibling patrols). For each entry from `loadReviewStatuses()`: skip unless `reviewStatus === 'pending'`; skip if `mergeStatus === 'merged'`; skip if `needsReviewDispatch(status)` is already true (reviewRequestedAt already set); resolve the project via `resolveProjectFromIssueSync` (src/lib/projects.ts:411) and skip if unresolved; read the per-issue record via `readIssueRecordSync` and skip if `pipeline.panDoneRecoveredAt` is set (tombstone). Then do a REST-only PR check: `gh pr list --head feature/<issueLower> --state open --json url --jq '.[0].url'` via the module-level `execAsync` (deacon.ts:50) with a 15s timeout; on exec error, `continue` (skip this cycle). If a PR URL is found, call `setReviewStatusSync(issueId, { reviewRequestedAt: now, prUrl })`, then obtain the record via `ensureIssueRecordSync(project, issueId)` (record.ts:439 — do NOT use the non-existent `buildDefaultRecord`) and `writeIssueRecordSync` it back with `pipeline.panDoneRecoveredAt = now`. Log via `logDeaconEventSync` and console. Wrap the whole loop body defensively so one bad issue never throws the patrol.

Wire it into `runPatrol()` (deacon.ts:2599) immediately after the anchor `const missingStatusActions = await checkMissingReviewStatuses();` (deacon.ts:2861): `const orphanCompletionActions = await checkOrphanedCompletions(); actions.push(...orphanCompletionActions); for (const a of orphanCompletionActions) addLog('action', a, state.patrolCycle);`. (The PRD's `runScheduledPatrol` reference is incorrect.)

Write `tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-orphaned-completions.test.ts`: (a) pending + reviewRequestedAt empty + no tombstone + `gh pr list` returns a URL → setReviewStatusSync called with reviewRequestedAt+prUrl, tombstone written; second call with tombstone present → no action; (b) reviewStatus 'reviewing' → skipped; (c) mergeStatus 'merged' → skipped.

items.title: Given an issue with reviewStatus='pending', reviewRequestedAt empty, no tombstone, and `gh pr list` returns an open PR URL, when checkOrphanedCompletions runs, then it sets reviewRequestedAt+prUrl via setReviewStatusSync and writes `panDoneRecoveredAt` into the per-issue record.
Given that same issue after recovery (panDoneRecoveredAt set), when checkOrphanedCompletions runs again, then it takes no action (setReviewStatusSync not called a second time).
Given an issue with reviewStatus='reviewing' or mergeStatus='merged', when checkOrphanedCompletions runs, then it skips the issue and performs no gh/API call for it.
checkOrphanedCompletions is wired into runPatrol (deacon.ts) and its recovery actions are pushed to the patrol action log; `tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-orphaned-completions.test.ts` passes.
